boards.name: Itris
boards.notes: Partners and Integrations page offers a Become a Partner form. Homepage describes posting jobs to multiple job boards from the CRM. Registered address is given without a country name.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Post jobs to multiple job boards and platforms with a single click, no copy-paste, no switching systems.

boards.name: Bizneo HR
boards.notes: Pricing page lists plans from 6 euro. Partners page mentions documented APIs but does not say how to get access. Homepage shows Spanish site with a language selector showing ES.

sources.title: Planes y precios
sources.quote: Planes desde 6 € a la medida de tu equipo

sources.title: Programa de partners
sources.quote: Déjanos tus datos y nuestro equipo de Partners te contactará

boards.name: ADP Recruiting Management
boards.notes: Site footer and About ADP page name ADP, Inc. as the trademark owner. Get Pricing links appear without prices shown. Language switcher lists Canada (English).

sources.title: About ADP
sources.quote: ADP and the ADP logo are registered trademarks of ADP, Inc.

boards.name: Homerun
boards.notes: Homepage states a starting price per month. Partner program offers reseller and referral partnerships. Integrations page lists job board integrations such as Indeed and LinkedIn.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Hire and manage your team starting from € 109 per month.

sources.title: Homerun Partner Program
sources.quote: The Homerun Partnership Program is designed to create mutually beneficial relationships with Partners

boards.name: Paycor Recruiting
boards.notes: Homepage describes posting generated job descriptions to job boards and a tech partners integration section. Plans and pricing page was not read.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Generate job descriptions and instantly post to job boards.

boards.name: Jobylon
boards.notes: Developer portal lists Feed API, Partner API and Push API. Integrations page lists partner job board integrations. Language switcher lists English, Svenska, Nederlands and Deutsch. Pricing page was not read.

sources.title: Developer portal
sources.quote: Our feed api, allowing you to list details about your available jobs.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Post roles across job boards, build branded career sites, and reach candidates where they are.

sources.title: ATS Integrations
sources.quote: Our partnership allows you to post jobs to their job board directly from Jobylon
